## Summary
- Split session bundle restore and backup decisions so `track-only` never restores but can back up under `session_bundle_mode: always`.
- Use fresh per-run exec sessions for debug bundle capture without reusing stable target/lane session names.
- Mark `track-only` uploaded bundles as debug-only/non-restorable and make restore/fork lookup ignore them.
- Update session continuity docs and focused tests.

## Tests
- `cd .agent && npm run build`
- `cd .agent && node --test dist/__tests__/session-bundle.test.js dist/__tests__/acpx-adapter.test.js dist/__tests__/session-policy.test.js`
- `git diff --check`

Closes #272

## Summary of PR/Issue
- PR #274 is a stacked follow-up to issue #272, building on PR #268’s `track-only` one-shot behavior.
- It splits session bundle policy into direction-specific restore and backup decisions so `track-only` never restores bundles.
- It also allows `track-only + session_bundle_mode: always` to upload debug-only bundles while marking them non-restorable.
- The core helper, registration, restore, docs, and focused tests are in place, but one workflow/runtime wiring gap prevents the main action path from meeting the upload criterion.

## Review
The core design is sound, but the shared action does not pass the new runtime dependency into the actual agent run step. That blocks the central acceptance criterion for `track-only + always` debug uploads in common paths.

| Issue | Severity | Description |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Run step does not pass session bundle mode | BLOCKING | [`run.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/3d84427e060d5188cddd2093f197b70d05c61441/.agent/src/run.ts#L540) reads `SESSION_BUNDLE_MODE`, but the shared action’s [`Run agent task`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/3d84427e060d5188cddd2093f197b70d05c61441/.github/actions/run-agent-task/action.yml#L298-L335) env block does not provide it. This makes the runtime default to `auto`, so `track-only + always` can fail to preserve a transient session for debug bundle backup. |

## Progress
- Issue #272 context was checked; the PR matches the requested helper split and non-restorable debug bundle approach.
- Existing PR discussion includes an orchestrator handoff and a passing rubrics review.
- No prior inline comments or review threads existed before synthesis.
- Posted one inline comment on `.agent/src/run.ts#L540`; no replies, thread resolutions, or minimizations were performed.
- Reviewer disagreement: one code review and the rubrics review considered the implementation shippable, while another review identified the missing action env wiring as blocking.

## Issue Details
<details>
<summary>Run step does not pass session bundle mode</summary>

**Cause:** The new runtime logic calls `parseSessionBundleMode(process.env.SESSION_BUNDLE_MODE)`, but `.github/actions/run-agent-task/action.yml` only passes `SESSION_BUNDLE_MODE` to restore, backup, and register steps, not to `Run agent task`. In the main action path, that means the runtime sees `undefined`, defaults to `auto`, and does not set `preserveExecSession` for `track-only + always`.

**Candidate solutions:** Add `SESSION_BUNDLE_MODE: ${{ inputs.session_bundle_mode }}` to the `Run agent task` env block. Add focused coverage for the action/runtime wiring so the runtime receives `always` when the shared action input is `always`.

**Comments:** This is narrow and safe to fix automatically; the underlying bundle policy helpers and debug backend guard are otherwise aligned with issue #272.

</details>

## Recommended Next Step
FIX_PR

A fix-pr pass can safely wire the missing env var and add focused regression coverage without needing a maintainer product decision.

## Final Verdict
NEEDS_REWORK

- [ ] Add regression coverage proving `track-only + session_bundle_mode: always` reaches `run.ts` as `always` and enables debug bundle session preservation.
